question: I would draw one card and I have two cards with dredge in my graveyard. Can I dredge more than one of them to replace that single draw?

expected.shortAnswer: No: one card draw cannot be replaced by multiple dredge abilities.
expected.answer: One card draw can't be replaced by multiple dredge abilities.
